baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun-adjective pair anchors a written object whose qualification concerns how it appears and communicates.
baseline_models.mechanism: Joined letters stabilize an address, while the adjective makes that medium both conspicuous and meaning-disclosing.

activation_trace.role: The writing branch supplies an inscription composed from joined letters and capable of carrying an address.
The appearance branch makes the inscribed object manifest rather than merely extant.
The expressive branch makes clarity an active disclosure of intended meaning through writing or sign.

changed_reading.after: A composed inscription that is visibly present and actively makes its intended meaning available.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two focus roots place joining and separating side by side.
baseline_models.mechanism: The book joins discrete units, but its clarity depends on preserving their edges; articulation is composition by controlled separation.

activation_trace.role: The joining branch supplies the binding operation that turns separate pieces into one organized object.
The separation branch preserves distinctions inside what has been joined, making articulation possible.
The interval branch supplies the legible spacing through which joined units remain relationally distinct.

changed_reading.before: Clarity is a property added to an already complete book.
changed_reading.after: Clarity is the book's architecture: it joins units by arranging visible boundaries and intervals among them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The book-root can denote binding determination, and the adjective can denote both division and manifestation.
baseline_models.mechanism: An inscribed determination becomes clear by fixing which side of a distinction holds and exposing the consequence as settled.

activation_trace.role: The decree branch supplies binding force, turning inscription into an operative determination.
The separation branch gives the determination a decisive boundary rather than a vague tendency.
The manifestation branch makes the settled boundary and its consequence inspectable.

changed_reading.after: A binding determination whose clarity consists in making decisive boundaries and consequences manifest.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The book-root can enroll names into a register, while the adjective-root can mark both ties and partings.
baseline_models.mechanism: The object makes affiliation legible by recording who belongs together and where one group or claim stops.

activation_trace.role: The enrollment branch supplies a register that assigns persons or names to an acknowledged group.
The connective branch makes the registered relation itself part of what becomes legible.
The parting branch marks the outer boundary of each recorded affiliation.

changed_reading.before: A text addressed to undifferentiated readers.
changed_reading.after: A relational register that makes memberships, ties, and exclusions visible without reducing them to one group.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opaque threshold and the dark delivery setting do not negate clarity; descent and durable increase make concealment a protected carrier through which disclosure arrives.

activation_trace.role: The written object remains the focus anchor whose mode of arrival is being revised.
Manifestness supplies the clarity that unexpectedly passes through rather than abolishes opacity.
Caused delivery supplies a movement by which the inscribed object reaches a new domain.
Night supplies an actual dark interval as the setting that carries the manifest object.
Stable, growing good makes the dark interval generative and preserving rather than merely obscuring.

structural_cues: Rootless 44:1 forms an opaque sound-threshold immediately before the oath, and 44:3 places delivery in night.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unrooted sound, night, descent, and durable increase; I infer that opacity can mediate disclosure. A live alternative is simple solemn framing with no theory of how clarity travels.

changed_reading.before: A clear book whose clarity should exclude obscurity.
changed_reading.after: A manifest book whose disclosure can be preserved and delivered through opaque sound and a dark interval.

context_deltas.mechanism: Delivery, differentiation, exactness, and dispatch convert the binding-book baseline into an executable order whose integrated determination is partitioned into distinct operations and sent into effect.

activation_trace.role: Binding inscription supplies the decree-like object that can govern subsequent operations.
Separation supplies the focus mechanism by which one determination becomes distinct executable allotments.
Delivery moves the determination from source into an arena of execution.
Discrimination between things turns focus clarity into an operation of allocating distinct affairs.
Exact construction constrains those divisions so they function as determinate operations rather than fragmentation.
Sending gives the differentiated decree an outward vector and practical execution.

structural_cues: 44:3-5 moves in sequence from delivery, to the differentiation of every affair, to dispatch from a source.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, differentiation, precision, and sending; I supply the arrow from these actions to an executable-document model. The alternative is that the book only reports operations performed independently of it.

changed_reading.before: A static binding record that states a settled judgment.
changed_reading.after: An executable dispatch: a binding determination delivered, decomposed into distinct wise operations, and sent into effect.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated cosmic 'between' language makes the focus collision of joining and spacing world-shaped: the book articulates a field by binding endpoints while preserving a meaningful interval between them.

activation_trace.role: Joining supplies the compositional act by which a plurality can become one ordered field.
The interval branch anchors clarity in meaningful spacing rather than only verbal explanation.
The connective branch keeps the interval relational, joining its endpoints without collapsing them.
The interval between heaven and earth gives the focus spacing mechanism a cosmic scale.
The repeated interval makes what lies between the poles a designed component rather than empty remainder.
Measured formation supplies a constructive rule for how the articulated field is laid out.
Reality fixed against falsehood prevents the mapped intervals from becoming arbitrary divisions.

structural_cues: 44:7 and 44:38 repeat heaven, earth, and what is between them; 44:39 denies purposeless construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated cosmic intervals and measured, real creation; I infer that the focus book mirrors this articulating architecture. The alternative is a scope claim about lordship and creation with no book-as-map implication.

changed_reading.before: A clear sequence of written signs.
changed_reading.after: An articulated relational map whose joined signs preserve the meaningful intervals structuring a world.

context_deltas.mechanism: Doubt is followed by a conspicuous dark haze that covers, a plea to uncover, and a manifest messenger who is rejected; clarity therefore means exposure or evidentiary presence, not guaranteed transparency or assent.

activation_trace.role: The inscription remains the object whose expected communicative success is put under pressure.
Manifestness allows clarity to mean conspicuous presence even when reception remains blocked.
Meaning-disclosure keeps the stronger communicative reading live beside mere conspicuousness.
Interpenetrating alternatives supply a receiver-state in which manifest evidence still fails to settle.
Smoky black turbidity supplies the paradoxical carrier explicitly qualified as manifest.
The repeated adjective marks an obscuring phenomenon as unmistakably appearing.
Covering supplies the obstruction through which the phenomenon nevertheless becomes evident.
Lifting a cover distinguishes removal of obstruction from the prior fact of manifestation.
The manifest messenger restores communicative disclosure but still does not compel acceptance.
Turning away makes rejection after exposure explicit, separating clarity from assent.

structural_cues: 44:9-14 orders doubt, manifest smoke, covering, requested uncovering, a manifest messenger, and deliberate turning away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contrary carriers of the same adjective and a rejection sequence; I infer that clarity diagnoses what is exposed in both sign and receiver. A live alternative treats each adjective locally, with no shared theory of clarity.

changed_reading.before: A clear book should remove ambiguity and secure understanding.
changed_reading.after: The book makes evidence and resistance manifest; its clarity can arrive through conspicuous obstruction and remain rejectable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The manumission-contract branch becomes live when a demand to render bonded persons, manifest authority, withdrawal, and an opened passage form a release procedure: the clear book can function as an instrument that changes status.

activation_trace.role: The manumission-contract branch anchors the otherwise strange legal-release reading directly in the focus noun.
Separation supplies the status boundary crossed when bondage is terminated.
Performance of a right or trust supplies the demand that a binding obligation be discharged.
Bondage and ownership supply the legal-social condition from which release must occur.
Compelling proof supplies authority for the status-changing demand.
Removal into a separate side supplies the first practical motion of release.
A wide open gap turns legal separation into an actual traversable passage.

structural_cues: 44:18-24 runs from the demand to hand over God's servants through separation and night movement to an open sea-passage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obligation, bonded persons, proof, separation, and opening; I infer a release procedure activated by the focus contract branch. The alternative is a rescue narrative authorized by proof but unrelated to any documentary instrument.

changed_reading.before: A clear book that informs people already fixed in their social status.
changed_reading.after: A clear emancipation instrument whose binding claim distinguishes mastery, discharges obligation, and opens passage out of bondage.

context_deltas.mechanism: Testing reveals a hidden condition, visible signs externalize it, and a final gathering is judicially separated; the book's clarity is thus an assay that produces evidence before it functions as verdict.

activation_trace.role: Binding determination supplies the verdict-pole of the model.
Manifestation supplies the assay-pole in which an inward condition becomes inspectable.
Assaying metal or persons supplies a process that reveals quality by pressure rather than explanation alone.
A visible mark supplies the external evidence produced by the test.
Testing that makes condition appear explicitly links trial to disclosure.
The repeated manifestation branch qualifies the test itself, not merely a verbal explanation of it.
Judicial separation converts disclosed condition into a decisive outcome.
Gathering first supplies the complete field upon which discriminating judgment operates.

structural_cues: The surah moves from an earlier human assay in 44:17 to manifest signs and trial in 44:33, then to the gathered day of separation in 44:40.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testing, visible marks, gathering, and judgment; I infer a single assay-to-verdict mechanism centered on the focus roots. The alternative is a series of separate historical and eschatological episodes.

changed_reading.before: A clear book that reports already visible truths and judgments.
changed_reading.after: A book that makes hidden states visible by trial, gathers the resulting evidence, and only then fixes a separating verdict.

context_deltas.mechanism: Food, molten residue, the hidden interior, experiential tasting, and prior denial move the binding inscription from semantic reception into the body; consequence becomes a somatic mode of reading.

activation_trace.role: The binding decree anchors bodily consequence as execution of what was inscribed, not an independent food image.
Manifestation is revised from visual or semantic appearance into felt bodily evidence.
Taking in and tasting turns an external object into an internal encounter.
Molten matter supplies the material medium in which the abstract sentence becomes physically operative.
The hidden interior supplies the site where denied meaning is made undeniable from within.
Experiential testing explicitly converts proposition into lived verification.
Denial of truth supplies the prior resistance that embodied verification reverses.

structural_cues: 44:43-50 moves from named food through boiling inside bodies to the command to taste what had been disputed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ingestion, interior transformation, tasting, and denial; I infer that enacted consequence is a bodily reading of the focus decree. The alternative is punishment imagery that confirms the book without itself functioning as reading.

changed_reading.before: A text whose clarity is read visually or understood propositionally.
changed_reading.after: A binding text eventually read somatically, as denied meaning enters the body and becomes tasted consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Failed patronal ties are followed by protected placement, secure standing, face-to-face orientation, and pairing; the focus register becomes a topology that dissolves ineffective adjacency and composes new relations.

activation_trace.role: Enrollment supplies the register capable of assigning persons to a recognized relational set.
The tie between parties makes relation, not isolated identity, the registered content.
Parting supplies the operation that removes failed or false affiliations before recomposition.
Mutual support and allegiance supply the old tie whose inability to help is exposed.
Self-placement within protection supplies the criterion for the newly secure set.
Established residence supplies a stable location for the recomposed relation.
Settled trust marks the affective quality of the new placement.
Mutual facing makes relational orientation spatially visible.
Pairing composes a new adjacency after the earlier failure of patronal proximity.

structural_cues: 44:41 negates help between patrons; 44:51-54 rebuilds the scene as secure placement, mutual facing, and pairing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed support and a later geometry of protected relation; I infer that the focus register redraws social adjacency. The alternative is a contrast of outcomes with no registry or topology function.

changed_reading.before: A register that lists already existing memberships.
changed_reading.after: A relational topology that exposes failed ties, separates them, and composes secure face-to-face affiliations.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ease, language-bearing tongue, message delivery, and recollection turn the written object into an oral-mnemonic interface; clarity includes low-friction re-performance in speech and memory.

activation_trace.role: Writing supplies the stable source that can be re-performed without ceasing to be an inscription.
Disclosure through expression or sign bridges the written and spoken modes.
Opening into ease removes friction from the object's movement into reception.
Light, compliant movement sharpens ease into repeatable oral circulation.
Language and speech supply the medium in which the written address becomes locally performable.
Conveying a message gives the tongue a transmission function rather than mere pronunciation.
Recollection supplies the reactivation endpoint for repeated spoken performance.

structural_cues: 44:58 refers to the delivered object with a pronoun, places it on the addressee's tongue, and ends with hoped-for recollection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ease, tongue, message-bearing, and recollection; I infer a written-to-oral interface. The live alternative is that the pronoun denotes revelation as discourse rather than a codex, though that still leaves both modes attached to the focus object.

changed_reading.before: A clear written artifact whose meaning resides on the page.
changed_reading.after: A written-to-oral interface engineered for easy vocal transmission and mnemonic reactivation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats the focus roots materially rather than as ordinary writing and clarity. It remains anchored in joining, pulled-apart adjacency, uncovering, an open gap, and a joint between pieces; downstream prose should present it as an engineered-aperture analogy, not a lexical replacement for 'clear book'.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes a root whose joining scope includes fastening material with a root whose scope includes pulling an element away from what it touches.

activation_trace.role: Joining and fastening supply the material seam that holds separate pieces in one structure.
Pulling an element away from its adjacent surface supplies a controlled aperture inside the joined structure.
Removing a cover gives the aperture a revealing function.
The wide open gap scales the revealing aperture into a traversable separation.
A joint between pieces shows how separation can articulate rather than destroy a composite whole.

changed_reading.before: A flat surface bearing clear text.
changed_reading.after: An engineered joint that holds pieces together while opening a controlled gap through which distinction becomes visible and passage becomes possible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is odd because it activates a land-tract branch of the adjective and turns the book into spatial administration. It remains validly anchored in the focus register and tract branches, then gains support from land, estate, and inheritance cues; downstream prose should call it a cadastral activation rather than claim that the noun literally means a land deed here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus can combine enrollment in a register with a visible tract or bounded stretch.

activation_trace.role: Registration supplies an administrative record capable of assigning occupants or claims.
The tract branch spatializes what the register makes legible as bounded land.
Productive land supplies the material domain to which recorded boundaries can attach.
An estate left behind turns spatial possession into a transferable record problem.
Transfer without a new bargain supplies the reassignment operation the register records.

changed_reading.before: A literary codex whose clarity is semantic.
changed_reading.after: A cadastral register that makes tracts, occupancy, abandonment, and succession spatially legible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is form-distant because it activates the root's 'during an action' time branch under the adjective. It remains anchored in the focus decree plus that branch and is reinforced by night, bounded duration, appointed time, and reciprocal waiting; downstream prose should retain it as a temporal-score analogy, not as the primary grammatical gloss of the adjective.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A binding determination is paired with a root branch that can mark time unfolding during an action.

activation_trace.role: The binding determination supplies a score whose events can be fixed before enactment.
Time during an ongoing action supplies clarity that unfolds in performance rather than appearing all at once.
A night adjoining its day supplies the first bounded temporal slot of enactment.
A duration supplies a later interval in which a scheduled event becomes visible.
Assignment to a fixed time makes temporal indexing explicit.
Reciprocal waiting closes the sequence with agents poised for the score's remaining execution.

changed_reading.before: A clear decree available as a complete static object.
changed_reading.after: A time-indexed score whose binding content becomes clear phase by phase as appointed actions are performed and awaited.

strongest_changes: Clarity shifted from guaranteed transparency to manifestation that can travel through darkness, smoke, covering, and rejection.
The book shifted from static text to executable decree and assay: it delivers, differentiates, tests, gathers evidence, and fixes outcomes.
Dormant legal and social branches produced coexisting emancipation and relational-register readings rather than one consensus gloss.
The written object remained written while also becoming orally transmissible, mnemonic, and, exploratorily, bodily experienced.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots sustain opposite but productive operations: joining and separating, recording and executing, revealing and exposing obstruction. Context did not settle one meaning; it repeatedly changed the scale and medium of the same two-root mechanism.
remaining_uncertainties: The balance between stative 'manifest' and agentive 'making manifest' remains live across the book, smoke, messenger, authority, and trial.
The emancipation, bodily-reading, aperture, cadastral, and temporal-score models depend on explicit branch activation plus reader-supplied cross-domain arrows, so they should remain exploratory.
The referent in 44:58 can be heard as the codex-like focus object or revelation as recited discourse; the oral-interface reading survives either option but changes emphasis.
